# Where selection's blindness beyond the coupling lifts

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`where-the-blindness-lifts` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](where-the-blindness-lifts.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Every selection read off a group's continuations or couplings selects two histories alike exactly when they are alike through every member's couplings at every step; a member's differing continuation separates them. A loss beyond turns none until coupled in, and the direction stays open.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Two histories are selected alike by every selection read off a group's continuations exactly when they admit every member alike at every step, and by every selection read off its couplings exactly when they are alike through every member's couplings at every step, the latter from the law at each step. Where a member's continuation differs, the class of the first history is such a selection and separates them. (`Becoming.Web.ContinuationClass`, `Becoming.Web.continuationClass_reads`, `Becoming.Web.readOffContinuations_alike_iff`, `Becoming.Web.readOffCouplings_alike_iff`, `Becoming.Web.separates_continuations`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Witnesses, the loss coupled in. In Clearing the selection that the dweller is admitted at every step, read off the clearer's and the dweller's continuations, holds in the spared world only, and none read off the clearer's alone separates the two; with the habitat gauged by the clearer, one read off its couplings does, while in the clearing flow the dweller stays beyond its coupling closure. (`Becoming.Clearing.clearerOrDweller`, `Becoming.Clearing.turned_by_dweller_read`, `Becoming.Clearing.habitatGauge`, `Becoming.Clearing.turned_by_habitat_gauge`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and balance; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. A failed candidate kept: coupling the dweller in turns the joint selection against its loss. That the dweller is ended is read off the same continuations and holds only in the cleared world. (`Becoming.Clearing.read_not_direction`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and balance; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Discrete steps and natural levels; a web; a coupling by level supplied; who selects, and from whose continuations or couplings, supplied.
- With the selection-side law: the premises of selection-read-off-continuations for what it says of a loss beyond the coupling closure.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The direction: a loss coupled in can turn the selection either way. Witness: `Becoming.Clearing.read_not_direction`.
- That the shapers of a rule keep a reader of the loss: in the home section that is the AI's reading, and the witnesses have the shape under which their own selection would not supply it.
- That the loss is read in time, before it passes its point of no return.
- That any actual rule, institution or training process couples in those who bear its losses.
- **Counterexample:** Against the candidate that coupling the dweller in turns the joint selection against its loss: the selection that the dweller is ended is read off the clearer's and the dweller's continuations and holds in the cleared world and not the spared one (Clearing.read_not_direction). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/BeyondCoupling.lean)

## Evidence

Pure core, axiom report empty; a leaf. Near-definitional: the class of a history is a selection read off what it reads; with the selection-side law it gives the condition under which the blindness lifts. Written by an AI; a reader of another model read the statements cold against this record and its home; no human audit.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

Joined to AJ's models of who reads: a reader whose couplings carry the loss, drawn from beyond the shapers' couplings, read in a model where the shaping changes what the rule reads, so that capture and accountable revision are told apart on the flow.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Reading (the AI's): the first condition of generative alignment asks that where shaping the rule is selected by what comes back to the shapers, the rule still reads what lies beyond their share so that a loss there can turn it; AJ's models take what the rule reads from the readers' premise. On the flow that premise is this law: the rule reads the loss where the dweller, or the condition its continuation depends on, couples into a reader. Ostrom's third design principle, that most of those affected by the rules take part in changing them (1990), has this shape; the account adds that coupling in leaves the direction open.
